## Typed gameplay

| Name | Description |
| ------ | ------ |
| [EventDefinition](interfaces/EventDefinition.md) | An event declaration that can be scheduled only in its recipient scope. |
| [EventDelay](interfaces/EventDelay.md) | Delay before an event is delivered. All fields add together; a month is 30 days. |
| [FocusGraph](functions/FocusGraph.md) | Build a complete focus graph from gameplay nodes, paths, joins and choices. |
